name: Jérémie
description: This summer, Jérémie is determined to mojo back! Haunted by a painful secret, the young woman finds refuge in a new job at the Domaine du Lac beach along with five lifeguards: Raphaëlle, Camille, Olivier, Thomas and Maxim. What better way to forget your troubles than partying in the sun?

videos.title: The Arrival
videos.overview: Jérémie Archambault starts a new life with her father and her brother, far away from the city, and gets a job as a lifeguard for the summer at the Domaine du Lac. Working at the beach is a new start for her, and she’d like to put her heavy past behind her. She joins a team of five lifeguards: Raphaëlle, Camille, Olivier, Thomas and Maxime. Rapidly, Jérémie realizes that she’s involuntarily disrupting the group dynamic.

videos.title: The Roommate
videos.overview: It’s Jérémie’s first day of work … and Raphaëlle is making her life difficult! Raph holds Jérémie responsible for her boyfriend’s misfortunes. Add to that Olivier, her cabin roommate, who turns out to be hard to pin down. After a bad performance for Thomas at his swimming competition, Jérémie gets chewed out by Philippe Cinq-Mars, her boss, for having “dared” to give Thomas tips. Her first day is turning out pretty bad … until her new friends come to her rescue.

videos.title: The Family
videos.overview: Day off for Jérémie. She and Maxime planned to spend the day together, but their plans are interrupted by a surprise visit from Mathieu and Benjamin. Jérémie decides to spend time with her family … which brings back some bad memories. For her part, Raphaëlle has trouble containing her jealousy when it comes to her boyfriend Thomas.

videos.title: The Beginning
videos.overview: Thomas is having trouble getting over his failure at the swimming meet, which causes frictions with his girlfriend and his father. During that time, Olivier and Jérémie are getting closer. The two roommates are getting along rather well … but they’re also hiding elements of their past from each other. During that time, Camille is trying to repress an impossible love… Is it possible that she has feelings for her best friend’s boyfriend?

videos.title: Camping
videos.overview: Jérémie, Max and Olivier have decided to enjoy their day off by going camping. It’s not the best moment because there’s a problem at the Domaine du Lac: Thomas has disappeared! Everyone is worried and looking for him. While camping, tensions run high and Jérémie, Olivier and Max’s expedition takes a wrong turn for one of them.

videos.title: The Return
videos.overview: Thomas shows signs of life. Jérémie encourages him to face his problems. Max and Olivier, for their part, are having a falling out. The camp trip didn’t turn out like Max hoped, and he blames Olivier. Camille falls under the charms of a boy … who might not be interested in her for the right reasons.

videos.title: The Friend
videos.overview: If Jérémie and Olivier wished to live the early days of their relationships in the greatest of secrets, it’s a complete bust. Their relation is revealed for all to see and no one is indifferent! Despite her happy mood, Jérémie is still repressing her past, which seems to track her everywhere. The arrival of Ève, one of her oldest friends, forces her to reveal a bit more.

videos.title: The Chain
videos.overview: Motivated by Ève’s recent visit, Jérémie decides to move forward, rather than exhaust herself denying her past. However, moving forward also has its lot of difficulties. That requires Jérémie to trust those she loves and who support her: her family, her friends … and especially Olivier. Will Jérémie reveal to her boyfriend that darker part of her life, even if it means risking being hurt once again?

videos.title: The 'I Love You'
videos.overview: Jérémie and Olivier are living a perfect life … even if Benjamin spends his days complaining, even if vacationers keep making trouble at the beach, even if the whole world is falling for Raphaëlle. Jérémie, for her part, is still living on her cloud. Free of worries, she has no idea of the drama that’s about to hit her.

videos.title: The Night
videos.overview: All the lifeguards are in shock after a nightmarish night. Will Jérémie and Thomas get out of it unharmed? That’s without considering Olivier, who’s been missing since he showed that less attractive side of his personality. Jérémie doesn’t know what to do to get out of this new infernal spiral.

videos.title: The End
videos.overview: Jérémie feels like everyone is appropriating her problems, like no one is listening to her. But for her part, what does she really wish for? Jérémie finds strength and courage that she didn’t know she had. Unfortunately for Jérémie, Olivier doesn’t have that strength.

videos.title: The Mother
videos.overview: The unannounced arrival of Anne troubles Jérémie. She feels like her mother has been undoing all the efforts she’s made to get better. But Anne is as headstrong as her daughter. She has no intention of leaving, even if her presence is disruptive for Jérémie, Mathieu and Benjamin.

videos.title: The Question
videos.overview: Jérémie keeps trying to pierce the mystery around Olivier, without seeing that he’s making efforts to get closer to her. Will what Olivier has to offer to Jérémie still suit her needs? Jérémie stop resisting her mother’s presence, and finally talks to her frankly. But her mother’s reaction is far from being what she hoped for…

videos.title: The Answer
videos.overview: Jérémie is at a turning point in her relationships. What is she expecting from Olivier? Is it a good idea to remain cabin mates? Will the gulf between the two ex-lovers get even deeper? And with her mother, is it still possible to fix what’s been broken? The decision is now Jérémie’s.

videos.title: The BBQ
videos.overview: The friendship between the six lifeguards is now going to be tested… What could be better than a BBQ at the trailer to have a fun evening. At least, until it all turns into a session of score settling. Is someone else at the Domaine making Jérémie’s heart flutter?

videos.title: The Guitar
videos.overview: Jérémie is recovering slowly from her drunken evening. Fortunately for her, an incident forces the lifeguards to close the beach. However, they still have tasks to complete. Jérémie decides to do them with Max, rather than with Olivier. Maxime sees that as a sign from Jérémie … but is it really?

videos.title: The Accident
videos.overview: Jérémie gets news from her college program. A program which has nothing exciting for her. Olivier notices and tries to convince her to listen to herself, but Jérémie is refusing to listen. She’s preoccupied by something else. By trying to help Max fix a mistake, one part of her past, which she had tried hard to forget, comes back to haunt her.

videos.title: The Photo
videos.overview: The lifeguards are recovering from a tragic accident. For some, they’re feeling anguish and sadness. For others, it’s made them want to intensely live every second. Jérémie, who’s watching over Maxime, thinks she knows exactly how he feels … but she couldn’t have guessed what he’s about to reveal to her.

videos.title: The Truth
videos.overview: When Olivier tells her that he’s going on a trip, Jérémie reacts with a frankness that destabilizes him. Stuck, Anne is also forced to be honest with her daughter. This new revelation upsets Jérémie who doesn’t know if she’ll have to do like her mother and lie to Mathieu.

videos.title: The Triathlon
videos.overview: Today is the day of the team triathlon for Jérémie, Camille and Raphaëlle, but an incident forces the girls to change their plan for the day. The lie about her past that Jérémie carries is becoming heavier. What’s more, avoiding a confrontation with Mathieu seems impossible. Will Jérémie find the courage to admit her wrongs?

videos.title: The Lie
videos.overview: It’s been a year since Fannie’s death. A commemorative ceremony is organized in her honour. Jérémie doesn’t want to attend. Fortunately, Olivier succeeds in changing her mind… almost. Jérémie chooses another way of reconnecting with her past, which finally allows her to make peace with the death of her best friend.

videos.title: The Before and After
videos.overview: Jérémie and Olivier realize that their past love lives are very different. Will they be able to get past these differences? The two lovers put their happiness aside, while they help Maxime who’s taken a dangerous path which might have grave consequences this time.

videos.title: The Intervention
videos.overview: Maxime is having a hard time! Jérémie can’t stand seeing him destroy himself like that. She takes matters into her hands and decides to help him. Unexpectedly, things get out of hand. Max, furious, reveals Olivier’s secret to the group. However, Olivier isn’t the only one hiding something. Jérémie learns that Camille also has a heavy secret.

videos.title: The Announcement
videos.overview: It’s a big day for Olivier. He is going to see his dad, which he hasn’t seen in years. Anxious over this meeting, he asks Jérémie to tag along. She is trying hard to reassure him, but she quickly realizes that Olivier’s worries were, unfortunately, well founded…

videos.title: The Last Day
videos.overview: The semester has started and the lifeguards meet up for one last weekend of work. What do they all wish for as the summer is coming to a close? And what about for the next one? It’s time to go over the summer for Camille, Maxime, Thomas, Raphaëlle, Olivier and Jérémie … even if some might not like the decisions of others.

videos.title: Autumn
videos.overview: To celebrate the end of an eventful summer, Jérémie, Olivier, Camille, Maxime, Thomas and Raphaëlle know that there’s nothing better than a starlit evening on the beach. All of them are looking forward to fall, even Jérémie. But fall might not turn out like she’s imagined.

videos.title: We Had a Good Trip
videos.overview: Jérémie is back from her mysterious trip. The joys of homecoming are quickly eclipsed by reality: the gulf between her and her loved ones is getting wider. Fortunately, Jérémie finds comfort close to the one who makes her heart flutter. But the calm doesn’t last. A piece of news comes and upsets her.

videos.title: Oli is Oli
videos.overview: Olivier is trying to escape his past, but reality catches up to him. His family problems lead him to come back to the Domaine and face Jérémie. Olivier couldn’t have guessed that his troubles would be far from over: Maxime has a bitter surprise for him.

videos.title: I am your Daughter
videos.overview: While Olivier’s father is still missing, Jérémie is afraid of missing her chance to meet Elliot, her biological father. She doesn’t know how their first meeting will go, but she finds the courage to face the unknown.

videos.title: I Don't Want to Force You
videos.overview: Since the death of a swimmer, Jérémie hasn’t been doing well. Max organizes a surprise expedition for her. Olivier is also struggling. His father hasn’t been found and he feels guilt towards Jérémie. Raphaëlle is the only who’s perfectly happy. Only one thing: her boyfriend doesn’t seem to like her friends…

videos.title: How Do I Do This?
videos.overview: Jérémie is torn between love and friendship. To prove to her boyfriend that she’s completely committed to the relationship, she has supper with Max and his parents. But Olivier receives bad news and would have needed her… Camille, for her part, has trouble getting respect as lead lifeguard.

videos.title: Do I Look Like I Play Tennis?
videos.overview: Max tries hard to hide it, but the complicity between Jérémie and Olivier is royally getting on his nerves! Following advice from her friends, Jérémie works hard to reassure her boyfriend. But the arrival of an unexpected visitor turns the lovers’ plans upside down.

videos.title: There's No Rush
videos.overview: Max has a big proposition for Jérémie, who doesn’t seem too thrilled. Raphaëlle wants to work on her career, but her boyfriend is doing nothing to support her! Camille, completely taken by her relationship with Étienne, doesn’t see any of this. But is he really the right guy for her?

videos.title: You Look So Much Like My Mother
videos.overview: Jérémie has all her plans disrupted by Mathieu, who’s embedded himself in her private life. Thomas’s ego is wounded when Benjamin ridicules him in front of his harem. But not as wounded as Camille. She never imagined she’d find herself in this situation! Fortunately, she does not let herself be treated that way!

videos.title: What I Want
videos.overview: Olivier’s father is finally ready to see his son again. Olivier is anxious about this reunion. But now is the time for him to face up to the demons from his past. It’s the only thing he can do to regain his confidence, in the future… and in love.

videos.title: You Can't Have It All
videos.overview: Jérémie feels fragile in her feelings for Olivier. She is doing everything she can to avoid him. An idea from Max is making this easier for her when he proposes a flirting contest between Thom and Oli. Camille is wondering about her future. Studying pharmacology is a simple option, even if it makes her feel sick to her stomach…

videos.title: We're Leaving
videos.overview: Jeremiah is forced to ask his father for a favor. Thomas is selected to take part in a preliminary training camp.

videos.title: Tell Me It's All In My Head
videos.overview: Jérémie refuses to think about Olivier, but, unfortunately for her, everything seems to force her to spend the day alone with him.

videos.title: You Ran After It a Little
videos.overview: Jeremy wants to explain himself to Max, but he won't listen. Jeremy finds comfort with Raphaëlle and Mathieu.

videos.title: The Mistake of Our Summer
videos.overview: The mood at the beach is tense. The lifeguards put aside their differences to celebrate Thomas's departure for Stanford.

videos.title: Question Mark!
videos.overview: The anniversary of Fanny's death shakes Jérémie and forces her to get closer to those she loves, or rather to the one she loves.

videos.title: Team Max vs. Team Oli
videos.overview: Jérémie hesitates between Maxime and Olivier. Max presents Jérémie with a heartbreaking ultimatum. The friendship between all the rescuers is in jeopardy.

videos.title: I'll Wait for You
videos.overview: Jeremy wants to change Max's mind. Olivier is growing impatient. Raph makes an important choice that will not be without consequences.
